releases.title: Standalone install, an AI copilot you sign into, a container action menu, and live updates
highlights: Standalone binaries — install with no Node/npm: one `ragedocker` executable per OS
Unified launcher: everything through `ragedocker` (tui · panel · mcp · ia · doctor)
Sign in to Claude or ChatGPT: `ragedocker ia login` (keys stored 0600, never echoed)
TUI action menu (Enter/m) over any container + animated status icons (breathe / spin / blink)
Open a shell, edit docker-compose, snapshot & restore, and attach extra volumes — in TUI and panel
Live update channel with changelogs in both the terminal and the web panel

releases.title: First public release
highlights: MCP server, web panel and terminal dashboard over one safe Docker client
Read-only mode and a container allowlist for locked-down hosts
